items.title: Self-Learning Software Developers: Thriving in an AI-Accelerated World
items.summary: In a world where artificial intelligence is accelerating technological change, independent learning is becoming one of the most important skills for software developers.As technologies evolve faster and knowledge becomes outdated more quickly, developers can no longer rely solely on formal education, traditional courses, or past expertise. The real competitive advantage lies in knowing what to learn, how to learn it efficiently, and when to apply that knowledge.In this talk, I explore how software developers can develop effective self-learning strategies and remain relevant in an increasingly AI-driven industry.The presentation covers several key topics:The Changing Developer Role: Moving toward higher levels of abstraction, broader responsibilities, and cross-domain expertise.The Economics of Learning: Understanding opportunity costs, diminishing marginal utility, and how to prioritize learning investments.Learning on Demand: Identify knowledge gaps, acquire relevant skills, and apply them to real problems.Learning Faster and Smarter: Using progressive compression, structured exploration, and practical application to accelerate understanding.AI as a Personal Learning Partner: Using AI-generated training materials, Socratic dialogue, and interactive feedback to improve the learning process.Building a Self-Learning Infrastructure: Develop sustainable learning habits, maintain continuous progress, and strengthen your ability to learn.A central message of this talk is that knowing everything is impossible, learning fast is essential, and knowing what NOT to learn may be even more valuable.The presentation offers practical insights for software developers, technical educators, and anyone looking to build a sustainable career in an industry where continuous adaptation is no longer optional.The goal isn't just to acquire more knowledge, but to get better at learning itself.Speaker: Haim MichaelConference: JavaCro 2026Blog: https://blog.lifemichael.com

items.title: Software Developers Evolution in the Era of Artificial Intelligence
items.summary: Artificial intelligence is fundamentally transforming software development. As AI tools become increasingly capable of generating code, software developers' roles are shifting toward higher levels of abstraction, system design, specification writing, and AI orchestration.In this talk, I explore how software developers' skills and responsibilities are changing and how professionals can prepare for an AI-driven future.The presentation covers the growing importance of T-shaped professionals, AI-assisted pair programming, mental models, precise requirements, system architecture, diagnostic thinking, code review, and continuous self-learning. It also examines how AI is enabling developers to build complete products and, potentially, AI-driven companies.It also highlights the shift from memorizing syntax and APIs to understanding core programming concepts, and the importance of working effectively with AI without sacrificing critical thinking.Three key takeaways:Coding is cheap. The challenge increasingly lies in defining intent, controlling execution, and verifying results.Specifications coordinate development. They provide a shared source of truth for developers and AI agents.Developers are moving to a higher level of abstraction. Their role increasingly involves designing systems, defining constraints, and orchestrating AI-assisted development.The future of software development is not simply about writing code faster. It is about developing the skills to design, build, and maintain better software with AI.Speaker: Haim MichaelConference: JavaCro 2026Blog: https://blog.lifemichael.com
